q: Do you wish to own a boat?
a:
Yes, I do because I love boating. I feel totally free when I'm out on the water. I can enjoy the sun and fresh air as well as the sound of water splashing around the boat.

或者：
No, I don't because the maintenance of a boat would be a lot of work. I wouldn't even be able to find a place to store a boat.
vocab: enjoy the sun and fresh air
享受阳光和新鲜的空气
the sound of water splashing around the boat
水在船周围溅起的响声
很有效的减轻压力的方法
get away from my daily routine
暂时离开日常生活的惯例

q: What do you do in parks?
a: I often exercise in parks, like jogging or cycling. Sometimes I also hang out with my friends in parks.
vocab: 和我的朋友们一起休闲放松
它是一个特别适合野餐的地方

q: Why are parks an important part of a city?
a: Parks offer a lot of green space. They are places where we can breathe fresh air, exercise and learn about nature.

q: What do you usually do in amusement parks?
a: I do a variety of things in amusement parks. But my favourite activities in amusement parks are riding a roller coaster and watching circus shows.
vocab: get away from the hustle and bustle of city life
躲开城市生活的喧闹拥挤

q: Do you think trees are important to us?
a: Yes, they're really important. Trees produce oxygen and absorb dirty air. They also make streets and parks look more attractive and provide shade in summer.

q: Do you know how to plant a tree?
vocab: dig a hole in the ground
put the tree in the hole

q: Do you think forests are important to us?
a: Forests are the main source of wood. They help us tackle global warming.

q: Do you have plants in your home?
a: Yes, I have some plants in the living room. Looking after them is quite easy and enjoyable.
vocab: Looking after the plants can help me reduce stress
照料植物可以帮我减轻压力

q: Do any flowers have a special meaning in your country?
a: Yes, some flowers have a special meaning in my country. For example, the peony is a symbol of wealth and prosperity, while the plum flower represents hard work and courage.
vocab: 是……的象征（The red rose symbolises romantic love.）

q: Do people give flowers as presents in your country?
a: Yes, it's very common to give flowers as presents in my country. For example, many people give flowers on special occasions, like Valentine's Day or wedding anniversaries.

q: Which do you think are better, real flowers or plastic flowers?
a: It depends on the situation. Real flowers look better and their fragrance is very attractive, so they're better for special occasions like Valentine's Day or wedding anniversaries. But when we just need some flowers to decorate our homes, plastic flowers are probably better because they are cheaper and last longer.
vocab: 装饰（动词），它的名词形式是 decoration
cheer up people who are ill
帮助生病的人振作起来

q: Do you often look at the sky?
a:
Yes, I do because I enjoy watching the different shapes that the clouds make. And at night, looking at the moon and the stars in the sky makes me feel calm and relaxed.

或者：
No, I don't look at the sky very often. But sometimes I look at the clouds in the sky to see if it's likely to rain.
vocab: the different shapes that the clouds make
感觉心情平静而且放松（近义：feel calm and peaceful）
